summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnishing unaudited interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The report includes certifications by the CEO and CFO, and is incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement. The filing contains no event triggering a special-situation classification — it is a routine periodic financial report with no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change.
